conditions.label: stage II colorectal cancer

modalities.evidence: abdominal or pelvic enhanced CT images

output.population: 230 patients with stage II colorectal cancer (CRC) who underwent radical surgery, excluding those with preoperative neoadjuvant treatment, concurrent other tumors, or death within 1 month after surgery
output.summary: Preoperative contrast-enhanced abdominal or pelvic CT acquired within 10 days before radical surgery in patients with histologically confirmed stage II colorectal cancer, with stated inclusion and exclusion criteria and documented scanner and contrast protocols.
